sources.title: brishen/iron-yunet-npu2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An IRON export of https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/main/models/face_detection_yunet for AMD Ryzen AI NPUs: the compiled NPU kernels (.xclbin + instruction streams) and the packed weights an IRON Rust runtime replays. The kernels are compiled for NPU2 (AIE2P: Strix Point, Strix Halo, Krackan) and will not load on NPU1 (Phoenix, Hawk Point). hf download brishen/iron-yunet-npu2 --local-dir yunet # or, from an IRON checkout: python scripts/hf_models.py download yunet --repo brishen/iron-yunet-npu2 --out yunet

sources.title: brishen/iron-taggerine-npu2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The kernels are compiled for NPU2 (AIE2P: Strix Point, Strix Halo, Krackan) and will not load on NPU1 (Phoenix, Hawk Point). The bundle is IRON's shared bundle format, version 9: manifest.txt (model params, one xclbin record per hardware context, kernel and matrix records), the tensor store tensors.txt + tensors.bin, and kernels/. iron/applications/taggerine/export_taggerine.py documents every record and tensor. hf download brishen/iron-taggerine-npu2 --local-dir taggerine
